convert_sailvos3d_scene_to_wai: run the sailvos3d conversion script to process a SAIL-VOS 3D scene into WAI format with images, depth, and camera metadata
convert_pixels_to_ndcs: convert pixel coordinates to normalized device coordinates using the pixels_to_ndcs function with x, y arrays and image size
convert_ndc_depth_to_camera: convert a depth map from NDC space to camera space using the convert_ndc_depth_to_cam function with an inverse projection matrix
process_sailvos3d_scene: process a SAIL-VOS 3D scene by converting BMP images to PNG, NDC depth to metric EXR, and generating scene metadata
run_sailvos3d_conversion_cli: run the sailvos3d module as a CLI entry point to convert all scenes from the raw dataset to WAI format
